controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS 2012 Cassini/Voyager mosaic, about 417 m per source pixel, downsampled to 8192 × 4096. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows adds approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Spherical shape approximation.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 enhanced-color composite, about 400 m per source pixel, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Colors extend beyond human vision into ultraviolet and infrared. Real hemisphere differences, residual photographed shading and source seams remain. Spherical shape approximation.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows height above the PDS 763.5 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 2.15 km grid spacing and 2.15–4.3 km typical estimated height uncertainty. Gray grid marks uncovered raster edges. The globe remains spherical.
